description: This file implements a command-line interface for managing NVRAM variables, including functions for opening, reading, setting, unsetting, and displaying NVRAM data, as well as a main function parsing command-line arguments.

methods.name: nvram_open_rdonly
methods.description: Opens NVRAM in read-only mode, trying staging first then MTD.

methods.name: nvram_open_staging
methods.description: Opens NVRAM in read-write staging mode if available.

methods.name: do_get
methods.description: Retrieves and prints the value of a specific NVRAM variable.

methods.name: do_set
methods.description: Sets a NVRAM variable to a specified value.

methods.name: do_info
methods.description: Displays information about the NVRAM header and usage.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Prints usage instructions for the CLI.
